description: Fix ModelSelect popover broken by Headless UI v2 incompatibility and improve AI Settings page layout

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect Popover.Panel rendering under Headless UI v2
tasks.description: Remove the `<Transition>` wrapper around `<Popover.Panel>` in the ModelSelect component (AiSettingsSection.tsx lines 257-265). Replace with Popover.Panel using its built-in `transition` prop for animation. This fixes all three selectors (Mohist Model, Coder Model, Stage Overrides) since they share the same ModelSelect component.
acceptanceCriteria: Popover.Panel renders in the DOM when the Mohist Model selector button is clicked
Popover.Panel renders in the DOM when the Coder Model selector button is clicked
Popover.Panel renders in the DOM when any Stage Model Override selector is clicked
Selecting a model from the dropdown updates the corresponding setting
Enter/leave transition animation is preserved using Popover.Panel's transition prop
Fragment import can be removed if no longer needed
tasks.notes: The fix is in ModelSelect component only (lines 257-265). All three selectors share this component so fixing it once fixes all instances.

tasks.title: Reorder AI Settings sections and add provider list visual grouping
tasks.description: Restructure AiSettingsSection JSX to render sections in new order: Model Selection → Stage Overrides → Connected Providers → Available Providers (collapsed) → Custom Providers. Split the flat provider list into connected (always visible) and available (collapsed by default with count summary). Add an `availableProvidersOpen` state for the collapsible available providers section. Remove the provider search input.
acceptanceCriteria: Model Selection section (Mohist Model + Coder Model) is the first section on the page
Connected providers render in their own always-visible section
Available providers render in a collapsible section that is collapsed by default
Collapsed available providers section shows a summary with provider count
Expanding available providers reveals the full list with Connect buttons
When no unconfigured providers exist, the Available Providers section is not displayed
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 since the popover fix must be in place to verify Model Selection works after reordering.
